cause_quote: Replacing the guarded callback with `onReasoningStream: async (payload) => { const visible = await progress.pushReasoningProgress(payload);` sent every reasoning chunk to the accumulator even when Slack streaming and status reactions were both off.
user_saw: With Slack streaming off, a long reasoning stream made the Gateway sluggish and delayed the final Slack reply.
summary: The fix skips Slack’s reasoning-progress merge when there is no preview to update.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit’s parent and confirmed that with streaming off and status reactions disabled, Slack left `onReasoningStream` undefined and skipped the existing accumulator. PR #137342 made that callback unconditional, so each chunk in the same setup reprocessed the growing reasoning buffer despite there being no preview.
